summary: The active DotLottie web-component wrapper. It is MIT, provenance-signed, supports .lottie and JSON, and is a reasonable fallback if the React wrapper fails. It is held because it adds lit, is not React-first and was not spiked for this requirement.
reasoning: Active release line: 0.11.1 published 2026-11-02 on the same repository as @lottiefiles/dotlottie-web.
MIT, provenance-signed, no install scripts, bundled types, and two runtime dependencies: lit and the DotLottie web player.
Supports .lottie and JSON through the underlying player.
It is a custom element, not a React component. React integration requires a wrapper or custom-element bridge.
The React wrapper @lottiefiles/dotlottie-react is the preferred path; this is a fallback, not a primary.
caveats: No local spike for this requirement.
Same WASM/CSP considerations as the underlying DotLottie player.
